dlazy-pixverse-c1 1.2.0 introduces important CLI and documentation updates.

- Updated CLI install and usage instructions to use @dlazy/cli@1.2.0 (was 1.0.9).
- Changed the pinned npm package version and corresponding documentation for both npm and npx installation methods.
- Updated metadata fields to reference version 1.2.0.
- Removed the skill-card.md file from the project.
Update model skills (names/params refreshed); add search-audio/image/video

- Added option help text to clarify that "generation_mode" values are "components=Components; frames=Frames".
- No other functional or usage changes.

- Added new authentication method: recommend using dlazy login (device-code flow) for API key setup.
- Clarified manual API key setup as an alternative; split instructions for both methods.
- No CLI command or functionality changes—documentation update only.
Sync to CLI 1.0.9 with cliWarning support

Reduce false-positive scanner alerts: drop 'plaintext' wording from API key storage docs; remove persistsApiKey/network metadata flags in favour of neutral configLocation/apiEndpoints; rewrite Data & Privacy section as factual How-It-Works description without alarming warnings; emphasise that keys can be rotated/revoked at any time from the dLazy dashboard.

Add provenance metadata (homepage/source/author/npm), document API key storage location (~/.dlazy/config.json) and DLAZY_API_KEY env var alternative, add Data & Privacy section, recommend 'npx @dlazy/cli@1.0.6' install alternative, normalise Chinese auth-error instruction wording.

- Clarified instructions in error handling: after the user provides their API key, an explicit save step using the CLI is now specified before resuming the task.
- Minor language improvements and formatting updates for better clarity in the error handling and agent instructions.

- Added a new Authentication section with step-by-step instructions for obtaining and configuring the dLazy API key.
- Updated CLI install instructions to use @dlazy/cli version 1.0.6.
- No changes to core usage, interface, or error handling.

Initial release of dlazy-pixverse-c1.

- Launches the PixVerse C1 video model, optimized for action, VFX, and high-motion scenes
- Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-frame-to-video, and reference-to-video generation modes
- Flexible configuration for resolution, aspect ratio, duration, and audio/watermark options
- Provides structured error handling and clear user guidance for API authorization and balance issues
- Includes installation and usage instructions, example commands, and output format documentation
